articles.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

articles.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
articles.snippet: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.
